abilities.effect: The glyph of warding targets the creature with a *spirit blast* (save DC 34).
abilities.name: Release Spell
abilities.trigger: A creature attempting to open the desk drawer or the secret door to area D6 triggers the associated glyph

hazard.description: An hourglass-shaped glyph flashes with mauve light, then seems to quickly drain its sand away, as if to indicate time has suddenly run out.
hazard.disable: DC 34 Thievery (trained) to remove the glyph without triggering it, or *dispel magic* (7th level, counteract DC 34) to counteract the glyph.
hazard.name: Glyph of Warding

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
